analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 49.6 maintains neutral zone, up from 42.2 five days ago, but confirmation of stabilization post-oversold exit needed. MACD histogram at 37806.8367 continues to improve, a significant rise from 690.7108 five days ago. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the current price of 1,688,000 KRW above the 5-day low of 1,486,000 KRW. Low trading volume ratio of 0.66 weakens trend reversal confidence. Weekly RSI at 51.7 and ADX at 41.8 indicate a clear trend. On the daily chart, the 52-week position is 48.8%, a neutral zone. Price is above SMA5 (1,617,600 KRW) and SMA20 (1,582,550 KRW) but below SMA50 (2,016,460 KRW). Approaching the swing support at 1,678,000 KRW. Consider buying upon confirmation of support at 1,678,000 KRW with accompanying volume.
